newsitem.title: USA: Quest Medical seeks strategic alternatives.
newsitem.headline: Quest Medical seeks strategic alternatives.

text.p: Quest Medical Inc on Monday said its board of directors hired Smith Barney and Rauscher Pierce Refsnes to seek "strategic alternatives" to enhance shareholder value.
The company, which makes healthcare products, said the alternatives might include a joint venture, strategic alliance, merger, sale of assets or other business combination.

"It has become clear to us ...that the current hospital consolidation trend, coupled with the pressure hospitals are under to keep costs low, is deterring hospitals from making timely purchase decisions on new capital equipment," it said.

"That and other factors have prompted us to seek a merger or strategic alliance partner who can bring marketing muscle and capital to bear so that we can place (Myocardial Protection System) instruments in hospitals," it said, referring to one of its products.
Quest Medical also said it foresaw a fourth-quarter loss of $0.05 a share.
First Call's analysts' consensus expected a profit of $0.04 a share for the period.
Last year, the company reported a profit of $0.02 a share for the same quarter.
